I is the identity matrix of compatible dimension.

evidence_excerpts: Second, if $v_1^Tx_0=0$, the initial vector contains no dominant component. In exact arithmetic, repeated multiplication cannot create that missing eigencomponent, so the method will not converge to $v_1$.
